content: Newsletter & Archived Communications Print Minus Related Pages Newsletters and Communications for Ambulatory Surgery Center (ASC), Healthcare Personnel Safety Component (HPS), and Outpatient Procedure Component (OPC) 2024 NHSN ASC Spotlight Vol. 1 Issue 1 [PDF – 3 MB] Updated November 2024 We are excited to present the first issue of the Ambulatory Surgery Center (ASC) Newsletter: NHSN ASC Spotlight. In this first issue you will find protocol updates, steps for enrollment in Outpatient Procedure Component (OPC), a data corner breaking down OPC statistics, and Healthcare Personnel Safety (HPS) updates. Training Newsletters / Members Meeting Updates E-mail Updates Health Department HAI/AR Programs Last Reviewed: November 18, 2024 Source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention , National Center for Emerging and Zoonotic Infectious Diseases (NCEZID) , Division of Healthcare Quality Promotion (DHQP)
